items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: my second kid was named Alexander Eugene Burrett

ctx.x: Two boys. Two boys. What were the names?
Well, the oldest one was named after me, Junior. And my second kid was named Alexander Eugene Burrett.
Yeah. So uh, so uh, oh, so we're getting back to Atlantic. You said you needed cash at the time. Yeah, I needed money. How much did Armored Ergun offer you at the time?
